title: Roanoke S3 resurrection correction: follow-through

scope.question: After the 2020-08-15 resurrection correction, what later captured S3 evidence establishes communication, acceptance, application, or reversal of the replacement rule?
scope.scope: All message shards 0320–0395; lexical discovery across every row after anchor, followed by channel-context review. Earlier evidence only to establish the correction baseline.
scope.exclusions: No prospective held-out Kit rulings, no corpus-wide frequency claim, no runtime changes, no audit-ledger edits.

broad.regex: \bre[sz]{1,3}(?:['’]s|es|ed|ing)?\b|\bresurrect\w*\b|\breviv(?:ify|ified|ification|al|e|ed|ing)\b|\braise dead\b|\bonce per day\b|\b(?:back to life|return to life|returned to life|bring.{0,20}back|brought.{0,20}back)\b

evidence.label: queue
evidence.observation: Brendon schedules Clover to resurrect Viola, Percival, and Abbadon.
evidence.note: one hour per person is in the next message

evidence.label: queue-duration
evidence.observation: Brendon specifies one hour per resurrection.

evidence.label: viola-report
evidence.observation: Percival's player reports Viola already resurrected and Percival next.

evidence.label: correction
evidence.observation: Brendon announces the balance correction and preserves that night's resurrections.

evidence.label: percy-countdown
evidence.observation: Percival's player says his return is 23 minutes away.

evidence.label: percy-return
evidence.observation: Percival's player narrates his return to life.

evidence.label: scroll-before-request
evidence.observation: Lilia's player requests three Revivify scrolls on August 7.

evidence.label: scroll-before-purchase
evidence.observation: Percival's player asks to purchase a Revivify scroll on August 7.

evidence.label: death-later
evidence.observation: Selene's player says dead dead in the later combat.

evidence.label: scroll-later
evidence.observation: Lilia's player uses a Revivify scroll on Selene and states return to 1 HP.

evidence.label: selene-after
evidence.observation: The revived player's account later posts 17/29 HP in the same combat.

evidence.label: scroll-planning
evidence.observation: Lilia's player asks whether four scrolls make preparing Revivify unnecessary.

evidence.label: slot-anxiety
evidence.observation: Another player describes third-level-slot anxiety associated with preserving Revivify access.

evidence.label: different-return
evidence.observation: Vee's player reports a later return to life and the end of a tether; mechanism is not established as Clover's rule.

evidence.label: clover-later
evidence.observation: Brendon later places Clover in the pub; the line does not establish a replacement resurrection rule.

evidence.label: voice-limit
evidence.observation: A player asks about joining voice chat to resurrect someone; this does not establish that resurrection occurred.

claims.label: commitment_followthrough
claims.claim: Percival's previously authorized resurrection is played after the correction preserves that night's resurrections.
limits: Player narration under prior DM authorization, not a second DM confirmation.
No claim that every scheduled return completed or that no later reversal ever happened.

claims.label: later_scroll_use
claims.claim: A later captured combat records use of a Revivify scroll on the account that reports being dead, followed by a positive HP report.
limits: Run by a different DM account; does not establish replacement-rule adjudication by Brendon.

claims.label: posthoc_causality_rejected
claims.claim: Requests to acquire Revivify scrolls predate the correction, so later use alone cannot show the correction caused a switch to scrolls.
limits: Does not prove the correction had no effect.

claims.label: replacement_rule
claims.claim: No exact replacement rule or explicit later application of that replacement was identified in this search.
limits: Lexical selection and captured text have gaps; voice, deletions, and alternative wording remain possible.

claims.label: transfer
claims.claim: This event does not establish a standing rule about every mistaken house rule.
limits: The existing SCOPE_OVERCLAIMED reusable-judgment verdict is unchanged.

excluded_candidate_examples.disposition: Voice-chat resurrection question; no completed resurrection established in the surrounding text.
Counterfactual discussion of a character as antagonist, not an actual Revivify prohibition.
Different return-to-life circumstance; not evidence of Clover's removed daily rule.
Word 'revive' occurs in a payment context, not a resurrection.

limitations: No complete semantic review of every row.
No claim of a replacement rule's historical absence.
No runtime testing or demonstrated player benefit.
